package postgres

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// ModuleSectionRepoPG implements ModuleSectionRepository.
type ModuleSectionRepoPG struct {
	Pool *pgxpool.Pool
}

func (r ModuleSectionRepoPG) ReplaceByModule(ctx context.Context, moduleID string, items []domain.CatalogRelationOrder) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	if _, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `DELETE FROM module_section WHERE module_id=$1`, moduleID); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for _, item := range items {
		if _, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `INSERT INTO module_section (module_id, section_id, "order", status) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,1) ON CONFLICT (module_id, section_id) DO UPDATE SET "order"=EXCLUDED."order", status=EXCLUDED.status`,
			moduleID, item.ChildID, item.Order); err != nil {
			return mapPgError(err)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func (r ModuleSectionRepoPG) Add(ctx context.Context, moduleID string, sectionID string, order int) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	_, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `INSERT INTO module_section (module_id, section_id, "order", status) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,1) ON CONFLICT (module_id, section_id) DO UPDATE SET "order"=EXCLUDED."order", status=EXCLUDED.status`,
		moduleID, sectionID, order)
	return mapPgError(err)
}

func (r ModuleSectionRepoPG) Delete(ctx context.Context, moduleID string, sectionID string) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	_, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `DELETE FROM module_section WHERE module_id=$1 AND section_id=$2`, moduleID, sectionID)
	return err
}

var _ repository.ModuleSectionRepository = (*ModuleSectionRepoPG)(nil)
